bibliographic.title: 20/20 hind/sight
bibliographic.author: chyrono
bibliographic.description:
Content Warnings: Needles (and their violent usage)

Tips: Spacebar to skip text animation.The keypad cannot be successfully cleared on the first go-around.

Outsmart your project lead and escape your erasure. You have only a few minutes.

But there's something else up your sleeve, isn't there?

It isn't over until the END.


Notes & Credits: Don't refresh the browser page as it will break graphics! Instead, open a new instance of the tab.
Background photos edited from Unsplash
Sound effects from https://jdwasabi.itch.io/8-bit-16-bit-sound-effects-pack

500 words, excluding keypad text. Made in ~2 weeks for the Neo-Twiny Jam 2025.
